headline: Summer transfer window: Grading big signings in men's soccer
description: The 2026 summer transfer window is open. Here is how we rated the biggest deals.

headline: Nico González signs for Newcastle from Man City for £52 million
description: Newcastle United have signed Nico González from Manchester City on a long-term deal on Wednesday.

headline: Chelsea offered chance to sign Villa's Emiliano Martínez - source
description: Chelsea have been offered the chance to sign Aston Villa goalkeeper Emiliano Martínez by his representatives, a source confirmed to ESPN's Mark Ogden on Wednesday.

headline: Palace boss: Expect Ismaïla Sarr to stay amid reported Liverpool interest
description: Crystal Palace boss Pierre Sage has said that he expects Ismaila Sarr to stay at the club, amid reports linking the winger to Liverpool.

headline: Man United's Bruno Fernandes eager to 'make it right' against Ipswich
description: Bruno Fernandes is determined to "make it right" against Ipswich and belatedly begin Manchester United's push to better last season's third-place finish having been given a bloody nose at Hull.
